scripts.title: Get all for FREE
scripts.features:
Features >

> Open VIP Area
> Give All Tools For Free
> Inf. Money
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(Game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()
local Window = Library:NewWindow("Script")
 
local Tab = Window:NewSection("Credits: TGMANKASKE")

Tab:CreateButton("Give All Tools", function()
print("HI")


local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GiveGP = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("GiveGP")

local tools = {
    "GiveBanHammer",
    "GiveFlyingCloud",
    "GiveFusionCoil",
    "GiveGrappleHook",
    "GiveGravityCoil",
    "GiveJetPack",
    "GiveLaserGun",
    "GiveMagicCarpet",
    "GiveRBSlap",
    "GiveSlap",
    "GiveSpeedCoil"
}

for _, toolName in ipairs(tools) do
    local toolEvent = GiveGP:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    if toolEvent then
        pcall(function()
            toolEvent:FireServer()
            print("Fired event for tool:", toolName)
        end)
    else
        warn("Event not found for tool:", toolName)
    end
end



end)


Tab:CreateButton("Open VIP Area", function()
print("HI")

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local targetName = "VIP, VipWall"

local function deleteAllPartsByName(name)
    
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == name then
            
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                obj.CanCollide = false
            else

            end
        end
    end
end

deleteAllPartsByName(targetName)

end)



Tab:CreateToggle("Inf. Money", function(no)
_G.GetWins = no
while _G.GetWins== true do
    wait() 

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local giveMoneyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("GiveMoneyEvent")

local moneyAmount = 99999999999 -- Money Value

pcall(function()
    giveMoneyEvent:FireServer(moneyAmount)
    print("Money event fired with amount:", moneyAmount)
end)


end
end)
